title: Common Architecture Language Model Decorators
description: Decorators attach supplementary information to multiple nodes and relationships simultaneously, enabling cross-cutting concerns like guides, threat models, business context, and deployment information

decorator.description: Supplementary information about elements of one or more architectures, kept apart from the architectures themselves.

$schema.description: URI of the schema that this decorator conforms to, for example a decorator standard

type.description: Type of decorator - a free-form string identifying the decorator category

target-type.description: Optional array of the types of CALM document that this decorator can target. The only type is architecture, because applies-to holds the unique-ids of architecture elements.

items.description: The kinds of CALM document a decorator can target.

target.description: Array of file paths or URLs referencing the CALM architectures this decorator targets

applies-to.description: Array of unique-ids referencing nodes, relationships, flows, or other architecture elements

data.description: Free-form JSON object containing the decorator's data
